plainText:
Jonathan Silver is a voice actor for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Silver was born sometime on June 26. In addition to acting on TV and theatre, he is a director. His first work on the Pokémon franchise was voicing Alain in the Mega Evolution Specials, before continuing to voice Alain and other characters during .
